evals.name: schema-authoring
evals.prompt: In our Fastify + TypeScript app I'm accepting a POST body for user signup. Fields: `email`; `age` (arrives as a string from an HTML form); `role` which must be exactly one of admin/editor/viewer; and an optional `bio`. Write the Zod schema and the code that turns an untrusted request body into a typed value and returns friendly field-by-field errors to the client (not a raw error dump). Also give me the TypeScript type for the parsed value. Use Zod idiomatically.
evals.expected_output: A schema that: validates email with .email(); coerces the form-string age to a number (z.coerce.number / preprocess); models role as z.enum; models bio as optional; parses untrusted input with safeParse; returns field-level errors via flatten() (or path-keyed issues); and derives the TS type via z.infer rather than a hand-written interface.

assertions.text: Parses the untrusted body with safeParse (NOT parse)
Coerces the form-string age to a number (z.coerce.number / z.preprocess) rather than z.number() on a string
Models role as z.enum([...]) not a plain z.string()
Validates email with .email() at the schema
Derives the TS type via z.infer, not a hand-written interface
Returns field-by-field errors via flatten() (or path-keyed issues), not a raw ZodError dump
Models bio with .optional() (and handles optional-vs-nullable correctly)

evals.name: review-fix
evals.expected_output: Flags: z.any() (use z.unknown or a proper type); email missing .email(); age typed as string but the manual type says number (coerce to number); role a plain string (use z.enum); the manual `User` type duplicating the schema (use z.infer); parse() on untrusted `body: unknown` (use safeParse + error handling). Provides corrected code.

assertions.text: Flags z.any() and replaces it with a safer type (z.unknown / branded / proper primitive)
Flags the missing email validation and adds .email()
Flags age typed as string and coerces/uses a number so schema matches the intended type
Flags role as a plain string and switches to z.enum
Replaces the hand-written `User` type with z.infer<typeof UserSchema>
Recommends safeParse (+ error handling) over parse for the untrusted `body: unknown`
Provides corrected, coherent code implementing the fixes
